**Sneak peek: SculptForge's own look** 👀
Coming in 0.10.7: **Forge Terminal**, a tiled, keyboard-friendly interface in Tokyo Night, with menus grouped by task (Sculpt · Paint · Mesh · Render) instead of a wall of palettes. Six more colour schemes are included (Catppuccin, Nord, Gruvbox and more), and on Linux it can follow your desktop theme.
Coming from ZBrush? The ZBrush-style layout stays one click away, and your current layout stays put until you choose.
Tell us what you think in #ideas.
